name: The Mad Angel

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: A slow melee swing on a six tick cadence. She throws three of them, then opens a special attack.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep Protect from Melee up the whole fight. Bring a golembane weapon.

mechanics.name: Sword Cleave
mechanics.description: She draws the sword to one side, then cleaves twice: once into the side she drew from, once back across where you were standing.
mechanics.counterplay: Read the draw and cross to her opposite side, not behind her. A side dodge makes your next hit land heavy.

mechanics.name: Exploding Light
mechanics.description: She lobs a ball of light at a marked tile. Left alone it detonates there for heavy damage.
mechanics.counterplay: Stand on the marked tile to punt it back into her. It can be returned three times in one throw.

mechanics.name: Lightning Smite
mechanics.description: Her eyes and sword glow blue while she charges lightning, then she fires a magic bolt at you.
mechanics.counterplay: Flick Protect from Magic on as the blue crackle appears. Nailing the tick also guarantees your next hit lands max.

mechanics.name: Enraged Smite
mechanics.description: Below roughly half health she enrages, opening with all three specials back to back and speeding the rest up. The smite becomes three consecutive bolts, the third arriving on a shorter gap than the second.
mechanics.counterplay: Flick Protect from Magic three separate times, tightening the gap for the last one.
